title: Purgatorio, Canto XXV: the souls in the refining fire ('E vidi spiriti per la fiamma andando')
date: 1868 (this page from the Berlin 1871 German edition)
note: Full-page plate scanned by the National Library of Poland (Polona), including the page margins. The seventh terrace, where Arnaut Daniel 'hid himself in the fire that refines them' (Purgatorio XXVI 148, quoted at l. 427). Doré made no separate plate for Canto XXVI.
